## Attributes

Attributes defined in the `lablet` namespace. Application developers are encouraged to reuse existing attributes; see these [naming recommendations](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/naming/#recommendations-for-application-developers) regarding attribute selection and naming for custom use cases.

| Key | Stability | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="lablet-run-stop-reason">`lablet.run.stop_reason`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | Why the run ended. [1] | `completed`; `max_turns` |
| <a id="lablet-run-turns">`lablet.run.turns`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | int | Number of loop turns the run took. [2] | `7` |
| <a id="lablet-tool-calls">`lablet.tool.calls`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | int | Number of calls to a tool during the run, `<key>` being the tool name. [3] | `[3]`; `[12]` |

**[1] `lablet.run.stop_reason`:** Justification: the GenAI conventions have no per-run outcome; `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons` is per inference call and cannot express budget or timeout stops.

**[2] `lablet.run.turns`:** Justification: the conventions count inference calls (`gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls` metric) but a lablet turn may hold several tool calls; the turn count is the loop's own unit.

**[3] `lablet.tool.calls`:** Justification: per-tool counts on the wide event so an analyst can answer "which tool dominated" from one row. Weaver template attributes allow a dynamic suffix and nothing else.

---

`lablet.run.stop_reason` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | The model called `task_complete` or produced a final answer. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `error` | A fatal provider or tool error ended the run. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `max_turns` | The run hit `run.max_turns`. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `timeout` | The run hit `run.timeout_ms`. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
